_about: Story frames by Azgaar journey type (data/journey-lore.ts). Tokens: {beast} {destination} {origin} {deadline} {faith} {dest_state} {place} {cargo}. Invention, provenance new.

default.premise: You have business in {destination}, a long road from {origin}, and it will not wait.
default.why_time: Whoever sent you needs you in {destination} by day {deadline}; after that the business is someone else's.

token.name: letter of passage
token.text: Bearer travels on our business to {destination}. Assist them. Expires day {deadline}.

default.contact: a courier who knows the road ahead

cargo.name: sealed parcel
cargo.why: It must be in {destination} when you are.

default.climax: You reach {destination} with what you were sent to bring.
default.failure: You reach {destination} too late. The business was settled without you.

Monster hunt.premise: The {beast} of {destination} has a price on its head, posted far from home. You took the commission in {origin}.
Monster hunt.why_time: The bounty closes on day {deadline}. Worse, the {beast} grows stronger each night it walks; hunters who come later find less to kill and more to fear.
Monster hunt.goal: Lay the {beast} of {destination} to rest before day {deadline}.

token.name: bounty writ
token.text: Writ of bounty upon the {beast} of {destination}. Payable on proof, if presented before day {deadline}.

Monster hunt.contact: a hunter who has seen the {beast}'s work

cargo.name: iron grave-chains
cargo.why: Only bound in cold iron will the {beast} stay down.

Monster hunt.climax: In {destination} you find the {beast}, and you lay it down for good.
Monster hunt.failure: The {beast} of {destination} is beyond any hunter now. The writ is worthless paper.

stops.bounty: Present the writ in {place} and hear what the bounty-keepers know.
stops.tavern: Listen for word of the {beast} at {place}.

Airship voyage.premise: Your ship sails the high air from {origin} to {destination}, and you are bound to her.
Airship voyage.why_time: The lift-gas is rationed to the day; past day {deadline} the ship comes down wherever she is.
Airship voyage.goal: Bring the ship to {destination} before day {deadline}.

token.name: ship's articles
token.text: Signed aboard for the voyage to {destination}. Gas reserve: to day {deadline}.

cargo.name: lift-gas cylinder
cargo.why: The last leg needs more lift than the ship carries.

Airship voyage.climax: The ship settles over {destination} on her last breath of gas.
Airship voyage.failure: The ship comes down short of {destination}.

Caravan.premise: You ride with a caravan out of {origin}, its goods promised to buyers in {destination}.
Caravan.why_time: The buyers in {destination} hold their price until the fair ends on day {deadline}.
Caravan.goal: Bring the caravan's goods to {destination} before day {deadline}.

token.name: bill of lading
token.text: Goods consigned to {destination}. Price holds to day {deadline}.

Caravan.contact: a factor with word of the markets

cargo.name: sealed sample case
cargo.why: The buyers will not pay without the samples.

Caravan.climax: The goods reach {destination} and the price holds.
Caravan.failure: The fair at {destination} is over; the goods sell for nothing.

Quest.premise: A vow sends you from {origin} to {destination}.
Quest.why_time: The vow binds until day {deadline}; after that it is broken, and so are you.
Quest.goal: Fulfil your vow in {destination} before day {deadline}.

token.name: vow token
token.text: A plain token. You know what it means.

Quest.contact: a hermit who knew the last person to try

cargo.name: offering
cargo.why: The vow is not kept empty-handed.

Pilgrimage.premise: You walk the pilgrim road from {origin} to the holy places of {destination}.
Pilgrimage.why_time: The rite in {destination} is held on day {deadline}, and only once.
Pilgrimage.goal: Reach {destination} for the rite on day {deadline}.

token.name: pilgrim's badge
token.text: A pilgrim's badge for the road to {destination}.

Pilgrimage.contact: an old pilgrim who has made the road before

cargo.name: votive offering
cargo.why: The rite asks an offering of every pilgrim.

Pilgrimage.climax: You stand in {destination} as the rite begins.
Pilgrimage.failure: The rite is over when you arrive.

Courier ride.premise: You carry a sealed message from {origin} to {destination}.
Courier ride.why_time: The message is worthless after day {deadline}.
Courier ride.goal: Deliver the message in {destination} before day {deadline}.

cargo.name: second dispatch
cargo.why: It must travel with the first.

Courier ride.climax: The dispatch is in the right hands in {destination}.

Expedition.premise: You lead an expedition from {origin} into the far country of {destination}.
Expedition.why_time: The season turns on day {deadline}; after that the way closes.
Expedition.contact: a guide who knows the far country

cargo.name: survey instruments
cargo.why: Without them the expedition proves nothing.

Treasure hunt.premise: A map bought in {origin} promises treasure at {destination}.
Treasure hunt.why_time: Others have copies of the map; whoever reaches {destination} first by day {deadline} takes it.
Treasure hunt.goal: Claim the treasure in {destination} before day {deadline}.

token.name: treasure map
token.text: A map with a mark near {destination}.

Treasure hunt.contact: a fence who knows who else is looking

Embassy.premise: You carry the voice of {origin} to the court at {destination}.
Embassy.goal: Present your embassy in {destination} before day {deadline}.

token.name: letters of credence
token.text: Letters of credence to the court at {destination}.

cargo.name: diplomatic gift
cargo.why: No embassy is heard without a gift.

Mercenary contract.premise: You signed for a fight in {destination}, paid in advance in {origin}.
Mercenary contract.why_time: The contract names day {deadline}; late is the same as deserted.
Mercenary contract.goal: Report to your paymaster in {destination} before day {deadline}.

token.name: signed contract
token.text: Contract of service in {destination}, from day {deadline}.

cargo.name: company banner
cargo.why: The paymaster pays the banner, not the swords.

Mercenary contract.climax: You report for the fight in {destination}.
Mercenary contract.failure: The fight happened without you; so did the pay.

Military campaign.why_time: The siege must be broken by day {deadline}.

cargo.name: siege powder
cargo.why: The walls will not fall without it.

Wandering.premise: You left {origin} with no plan but {destination}.
Wandering.why_time: Your money runs out on day {deadline}.
Wandering.failure: You run out of road and money.

Refugee flight.why_time: The pursuit will close the roads by day {deadline}.

cargo.name: family heirloom
cargo.why: It is all that is left.

Exile's flight.premise: Exiled from {origin}, you are bound for {destination}.
Exile's flight.why_time: The writ of exile gives you until day {deadline} to cross the last border.

cargo.name: proof of innocence
cargo.why: You mean to come back one day.

Smuggling run.premise: You run goods from {origin} to buyers in {destination}.

token.name: coded ledger
token.text: Numbers that mean something to someone.

Raid.premise: Your band rides from {origin} to strike {destination}.

Royal progress.premise: You travel in the royal train from {origin} to {destination}.
Royal progress.why_time: The court must be in {destination} by day {deadline}.

cargo.name: regalia case
cargo.why: There is no ceremony without it.

Royal progress.failure: The ceremony goes on without the court.

Arcane errand.premise: A mage in {origin} sends you to {destination} on an errand they will not explain.
Arcane errand.why_time: The working must be done by the conjunction on day {deadline}.
Arcane errand.goal: Complete the errand in {destination} before day {deadline}.

token.name: warded scroll
token.text: Signs that hurt to look at.
